sources.title: Components of Hilbert schemes
sources.inspection: Problem 25, page 3; unrestricted three-variable question and separate 26-variable remark. Primary PDF text and page image inspected.

sources.title: Multigraded Hilbert Schemes
sources.inspection: General definition allows infinite-dimensional ambient homogeneous pieces; quotient pieces have finite locally free ranks. Example 1.4 and Proposition 1.5 checked.

sources.title: The toric Hilbert scheme of a rank two lattice is smooth and irreducible
sources.inspection: Theorem 1.1, arbitrary rank-two lattices; standing arbitrary infinite field. Geometric use via algebraic closure checked. Full combinatorial construction not independently replayed.

sources.title: Smooth and irreducible multigraded Hilbert schemes
sources.inspection: Theorem 1.1 applies to arbitrary abelian gradings in two variables. No extension to three-variable irreducibility inferred.

sources.title: The T-graph of a multigraded Hilbert scheme
sources.inspection: Theorem 1.1 and Section 2.3: equivariant positive-grading finite-support reduction over arbitrary commutative base. Graph connectedness criterion keeps the positive/complex scope.

sources.title: Non-connected toric Hilbert schemes
sources.inspection: Theorem 1: 26- and 50-variable disconnected toric examples; nonhomogeneous distinction retained. Full large construction not independently replayed.

sources.title: Disconnected multigraded Hilbert schemes on P^2 x P^1
sources.inspection: Complete proof of Theorem A and Proposition 2.2, Corollary 2.4, and Corollary 2.8 checked. Current public record contains v1 dated 2026-08-07 and no journal reference. No peer-review claim.

sources.title: Uniform bounds on multigraded regularity
sources.inspection: Theorem 6.2 and proof, including full-function extension of the upper-orthant truncation for the standard bigrading. Uniform region must cover the entire sheaf Hilbert functor.

sources.title: Syzygies over a Polynomial Ring
sources.inspection: Standing field C on page 1; Section 9 fixed-function deformation discussion. No stronger field statement inferred.

sources.title: Hilbert schemes of 8 points
sources.inspection: Standing characteristic neither 2 nor 3 and Theorem 3.5 component description checked. No transfer of component statements to characteristics 2 or 3.

limits: Original Pardue full text remains uninspected; author reported host blocking. The audit relies only on the inspected exposition for its stated field scope.
The search is targeted, not a proof of absence of a three-variable resolution.
